function_v0.doc:
One-time constructor, run atomically at deploy
(`stellar contract deploy \xe2\x80\xa6 -- --admin \xe2\x80\xa6 --usdc_token \xe2\x80\xa6`). There is no
separate `initialize` call and thus no uninitialized window; the config
is guaranteed present the instant the contract exists.

`quote_signer` is the raw ed25519 public key of the off-chain quote
signer. `network_id` binds quotes to this deployment's network
(testnet = 1, mainnet = 2).
function_v0.name: __constructor

function_v0.doc:
Sole entry point for user payments. Validates the backend-signed
quote, pulls `amount` USDC from the payer into escrow, and creates the
order in `Paid` status.

Validation runs in a fixed order, so the first failing condition
determines the error surfaced:
paused -> denylist -> treasury/enabled -> amount -> quote expiry ->
signature -> duplicate intent -> balance/allowance.

Token movement uses SEP-41 `transfer_from` with the router as spender,
which is why the payer must have `approve`d the router beforehand.
function_v0.name: pay_order

function_v0.doc:
Attester confirms off-chain fulfillment. Releases escrowed USDC to the
service treasury and stores the opaque `fulfillment_ref_hash`.

Remains callable while paused, after the refund TTL (as long as the
order is still `Paid`), and for disabled
services (disabling only blocks *new* payments).
function_v0.name: attest_fulfillment

function_v0.doc:
Returns escrowed USDC to the payer.

Until `expires_at_ledger + REFUND_GRACE_LEDGERS`, only the attester may
refund (`AttesterInitiated`). On or after that point the call is
permissionless (`TtlExpired`) \xe2\x80\x94 no auth is required from anyone. The
grace window past the nominal TTL gives the attester an exclusive
settlement buffer so a slightly-late `attest_fulfillment` cannot be
front-run by a permissionless refund. Remains callable while paused.
function_v0.name: refund

function_v0.doc: Full order record. Errors with `OrderNotFound` if unknown.
function_v0.name: get_order

function_v0.doc: Order lifecycle status. Errors with `OrderNotFound` if unknown.
function_v0.name: get_order_status

function_v0.doc: Treasury configuration for a service type.
function_v0.name: get_treasury

function_v0.doc: Transfer the admin role. Emits `config_updated` attributed to the\nacting (outgoing) admin.
function_v0.name: set_admin

function_v0.doc: Rotate the quote signer (raw ed25519 public key).
function_v0.name: set_quote_signer

function_v0.doc:
Configure a service treasury. Must be called for a `ServiceType`
before that service accepts payments.

Routing is by `service_type`, resolved at settlement time: an `Order`
stores only its service, not a treasury snapshot. Changing a service's
`treasury_address` therefore redirects settlement of already-`Paid`
orders for that service to the new address (see the
`set_treasury_rotation_redirects_settlement` test). Rotate with that in
mind, or drain in-flight orders first.
function_v0.name: set_treasury

function_v0.doc: Emergency pause. Blocks `pay_order` only; `attest_fulfillment` and\n`refund` remain callable for existing `Paid` orders.
function_v0.name: set_paused

function_v0.doc: Update the default refund window. Affects only orders paid after the\nchange; existing orders keep their recorded `expires_at_ledger`.
function_v0.name: set_default_ttl

function_v0.doc: Block an address from calling `pay_order`. Does not affect refunds of\nexisting escrow (the payer must always be refundable).
function_v0.name: add_to_denylist

event_v0.doc:
`order_paid`. Subscribers begin off-chain fulfillment.

The struct name provides the fixed `"order_paid"` topic (snake_case of the
type), `#[topic]` adds `intent_id` as a second topic, and the remaining
fields form the data payload. `data_format = "vec"` keeps the payload a
positional tuple/vec (the wire layout consumers rely on).
event_v0.name: OrderPaid

event_v0.doc:
`config_updated`, emitted for scalar config fields
(`admin`, `attester`, `quote_signer`, `paused`, `default_ttl`).

Treasury and denylist changes carry extra detail, so they get their own
typed events ([`TreasuryConfigured`], [`DenylistChanged`]) rather than this
coarse one \xe2\x80\x94 a refinement of the original single `config_updated` event.

The mutated field is a dynamic second topic (`Symbol`), and the acting
admin is the sole data value \xe2\x80\x94 hence `data_format = "single-value"`.
event_v0.name: ConfigUpdated

event_v0.doc: `treasury_configured`: emitted by `set_treasury`. Carries which service was\n(re)configured, its treasury address, and whether it is enabled, so\nindexers can track routing changes without re-reading contract state.
event_v0.name: TreasuryConfigured

event_v0.doc: `denylist_changed`: emitted by `add_to_denylist` / `remove_from_denylist`.\nThe affected address is an indexed topic; `denied` gives the new state.
event_v0.name: DenylistChanged

udt_union_v0.doc:
Storage keys for all contract data.

- `Config` and `Treasury(_)` live in **instance** storage (small, bounded
set: one config + at most eight treasuries).
- `Order(_)` and `Denylist(_)` live in **persistent** storage (unbounded).
udt_union_v0.name: DataKey

tuple_v0.doc: Denylist entry. Presence with `true` means denied.
tuple_v0.name: Denylist

udt_struct_v0.doc:
Global configuration.

Two fields differ from a plain config, both required by Soroban primitives:
- `quote_signer` is stored as the raw 32-byte ed25519 public key
(`BytesN<32>`) rather than an `Address`, because
`env.crypto().ed25519_verify` operates on raw keys.
- `network_id` (u32; testnet = 1, mainnet = 2) is stored so the contract
can bind quote hashes to the network (preventing cross-network replay).
udt_struct_v0.name: Config

fields.doc: Refund window after payment, in ledgers.
fields.name: default_ttl_ledgers

fields.doc: Network identifier bound into quote hashes (testnet = 1, mainnet = 2).
fields.name: network_id

fields.doc: When true, new payments are blocked.
fields.name: paused

fields.doc: Ed25519 public key used to verify quote signatures.
fields.name: quote_signer

fields.name: enabled

fields.doc: Per-service TTL override; falls back to `default_ttl_ledgers`.
fields.name: ttl_ledgers

udt_struct_v0.doc: Order record. Created atomically on the first successful `pay_order`; there\nis no pre-payment registration step.
